name: Talisman of Obsidian
text: In each phase, ignore the first damage point allocated to the general.

name: Amulet of Burning Hate
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase: until the end of the turn, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ for the general's attacks is a critical hit.

name: Chalice of Darkness
text: Once per battle, in your shooting phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of the general. That unit suffers D3 mortal damage.

name: Scroll of Petrification
text: Once per battle, in any hero phase: until the end of the turn the general has Ward (2+), but it cannot use abilities and friendly abilities cannot pick it.
